youtube.title: OKX Invite Code: What It Is and How to Use It (2026)
youtube.description:
An OKX invite code is the code an existing user shares so a new user can link their account at sign-up. In everyday use, invite code and referral code mean the same thing and go into the same field.

Referral code: XOACPQFC

This video explains how OKX invites work, the four steps to use an invite code, why each new account links to one inviter, what the VIP invite codes you see online usually are, and what to do on your first day after joining.

FAQ
Is an OKX invite code the same as a referral code?
In practice, yes. Both go into the same invite or referral field at sign-up.
What is an OKX VIP invite code?
Usually a label on a personal code. VIP tiers follow OKX's own rules on the official fee page.
Where do I find my own OKX invite code?
In the invite or referral section of the app menu, once your account is active.

Updated: November 2026
